VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeDef.description: A small insectoid, genetically modified to produce small batches of Luciferium extract every few days. Even though they are useful as a source of the dangerous drug, the fact that Luciferium is a mechanite-based drug makes luciferbugs extremely unstable, and prone to violent detonation if damaged.
